mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, node_name, description, system_prompt, temperature, tools, model, node_type, schema_key, code_key, output, create_time, update_time FROM sys_agent_node WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_agent_node ( agent_id, node_name, description, system_prompt, temperature, tools, model, node_type, schema_key, code_key, output, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{agentId}, #{nodeName}, #{description}, #{systemPrompt}, #{temperature}, #{tools}, #{model}, #{nodeType}, #{schemaKey}, #{codeKey}, #{output}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_agent_node SET node_name = #{nodeName}, description = #{description}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, temperature = #{temperature}, tools = #{tools}, model = #{model}, node_type = #{nodeType}, schema_key = #{schemaKey}, code_key = #{codeKey}, output = #{output}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
